verification.renderedLayout: Selected phone home, games, Paintings category, profile and demo login captures inspected. Wide home captured by restoration test. No whole-surface approval.
verification.accessibility: UNVERIFIED as a whole; source semantics and narrow large-text test coverage are not a full accessibility audit.
verification.executedValidation: Coordinating pass reports clean analysis, 9 Flutter tests, 10 backend tests, web JavaScript build and Android debug APK build passing. See docs/VALIDATION.md.
verification.samples: Illustrative self-contained HTML/CSS translations only. Raster silhouettes, fonts and Material state details are not faithfully rendered by these samples. Flutter source and original assets are authoritative.
verification.tonalRamps: Existing synthesized preview ramps retained as display metadata only, not application tokens. Newly extracted colors have no invented production ramps.
verification.logicalPixels: DESIGN.md px values map to authored Flutter logical pixels before scaling.
verification.runtimeBehavior: Physical-device runtime, connected Firebase auth/OAuth, live map tiles and Unity integration are unverified; Unity remains deferred.
verification.detector: No Flutter design detector; manual extraction.
verification.captureMethod: Flutter test renderer; capture path loads real fonts and precaches image assets. Not physical-native screenshots.

narrative.overview:
Varasa restores the original supplied interface: shaped parchment headers, curved illustrated navigation, cream social stories, floral login, arch game cards and an ornamental profile. The five images in `.impeccable/references/` and the original project assets govern this identity. The owner rejected the intervening generic composition; keeping only its palette and logo is insufficient.

Artwork defines the structure as well as the decoration. Preserve its silhouettes and pair decorative cultural headings with the warm handwritten voice of social stories. Backend and repository improvements remain behind this interface. This document records the current restoration, not whole-surface approval or a new visual direction.
keyCharacteristics: Original shaped PNG artwork retained as structural chrome.
White canvas, cream stories, parchment framing and brown ink.
CinzelDecorative headings, CormorantGaramond titles and Itim social copy.
Curved illustrated mobile navigation with a prominent plus and avatar.
Honest demo, loading, error and unavailable-game states.

rules.name: The Original Artwork Rule
rules.body: Preserve the supplied asset colors and silhouettes; do not replace them with generic rectangles or a newly invented ornament system.

rules.name: The Reading Voice Rule
rules.body: Preserve Itim on social copy while leaving forms and utility controls readable in their existing Material text styles.

dos: Do preserve the original shaped assets and supplied screenshot composition.
Do keep caption-first cream stories and the illustrated mobile navigation.
Do preserve Posts above Followers / Following and label incomplete counts as loaded.
Do keep Friends and account tools in Community & account.
Do retain functional loading, error, demo and unavailable-game states.
Do keep wide and large-text adaptations faithful to the same artwork and hierarchy.
donts: Don't reintroduce the rejected generic cards, rectangular headers or labeled mobile bar.
Don't crop away the game arches, floral frame or ornamental profile shape.
Don't replace original article text or claim that Unity is playable.
Don't treat demo captures, successful builds or browser samples as connected/native runtime verification.
Don't describe this document as whole-surface visual or accessibility approval.
